subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Companion make `2026.7.2-beta.2` its default before an official package containing the wizard-runtime correction has passed the full supported setup path?
rationale: The code can be mechanically changed either way, but only maintainers can choose whether a known-failing prerelease is an acceptable default or whether the integration must wait for a published upstream correction.

options.title: Wait for an official corrected package
options.body: Keep the PR open or split it, then select a new default only after the exact published artifact completes Companion setup without injected packages.

options.title: Land only independent Companion fixes
options.body: Remove the beta-default change and preserve the locale, lifecycle, and test fixes that can be validated against the existing supported release.

options.title: Accept an experimental beta default
options.body: Approve the beta default with explicit release notes and a visible recovery path despite the documented wizard failure risk.

recommendation.title: Wait for an official corrected package
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open or split it, then select a new default only after the exact published artifact completes Companion setup without injected packages.

likelyOwner.reason: The available implementation history most directly connects CassieMei to the setup and wizard lifecycle surface, although the release-policy decision needs broader maintainer sponsorship.
